## Content boundaries
- Articles are human-reviewed professional material.
- Project demonstrations use static, mock or browser-local data.
- InfraDispatch is a smart rule-based dispatch planner/demo, not a live production platform.
- Dynamic tourism facts require verification against current approved sources.
